pages.lesson:
LESSON: KUANDIKA 3.3.1 INSHA ZA KUBUNI MASIMULIZI

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.3: Kuandika 3.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Masimulizi

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Kuandika 3.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Masimulizi. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kutambua vipengele vya kufafanulia ujumbe wa insha ya masimulizi
2. kufafanua ujumbe wa insha ya masimulizi kupitia kwa utangulizi kiini na hitimisho
3. kufafanua ujumbe wa insha ya masimulizi kupitia kwa wahusika

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kutambua vipengele vya kufafanulia ujumbe wa insha ya masimulizi
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua vipengele vya kufafanulia ujumbe wa insha ya masimulizi. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kufafanua ujumbe wa insha ya masimulizi kupitia kwa utangulizi kiini na hitimisho
   In simple words: practise until you can kufafanua ujumbe wa insha ya masimulizi kupitia kwa utangulizi kiini na hitimisho. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. kufafanua ujumbe wa insha ya masimulizi kupitia kwa wahusika
   In simple words: practise until you can kufafanua ujumbe wa insha ya masimulizi kupitia kwa wahusika. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Kuandika 3.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Masimulizi using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Kuandika 3.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Masimulizi in the examples.
2. Explain Kuandika 3.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Masimulizi to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Kuandika 3.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Masimulizi.
4. Show that you can: kutambua vipengele vya kufafanulia ujumbe wa insha ya masimulizi

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Kuandika 3.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Masimulizi using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Kuandika 3.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Masimulizi important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kutambua vipengele vya kufafanulia ujumbe wa insha ya masimulizi
2. kufafanua ujumbe wa insha ya masimulizi kupitia kwa utangulizi kiini na hitimisho
3. kufafanua ujumbe wa insha ya masimulizi kupitia kwa wahusika

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
